title: Mayor Gloria Joins Students and Volunteers for Encanto Community Park Tree Planting
description: SAN DIEGO – Mayor Todd Gloria will join City staff, community volunteers and fourth grade students from Encanto Elementary School for a tree planting and park beautification project on Friday, Oct. 3, at Encanto Community Park. Ready, Set, Grow San Diego project participants will work together to plant approximately 20 new trees that will beautify the area and provide additional shade for park users.
